reason: Before a ride I have coffee at home, and on the trail I drink water from my bottle. A fizzy can doesn't fit into either, and I'm not ordering from some separate e-shop when my groceries already come from Rohlík.
objection: I already get clean caffeine from coffee and matcha for a few crowns a cup. 55 CZK for a can of flavoured mate is just paying for packaging I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: Finding it cold in the fridge at a café at the end of a hike or ride, or being able to add it to my Rohlík order, so I could try one without going out of my way.
